records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 17 项中最高是 Phones(75,119.47),其次 Copiers(52,315.19),最低 Supplies(-89.85)。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Phones(417,939.31)。其中有 1 项为负值,如实画出。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales <> 0
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales
FROM (
  SELECT sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE t.rn IN ((t.n + 1) / 2, (t.n + 2) / 2)
